title: Winslow Asset Management Inc. Has $21.75 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Winslow Asset Management Inc. trimmed its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.1% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 96,330 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,100 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for approximately 4.0% of Winslow Asset Management Inc.’s holdings, making the stock its 2nd biggest holding. Winslow Asset Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $21,746,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of the stock. First Hawaiian Bank increased its position in Apple by 33.5% during the 2nd quarter. First Hawaiian Bank now owns 10,012 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,854,000 after purchasing an additional 2,510 shares during the period. Peavine Capital LLC increased its position in Apple by 428.7% during the 2nd quarter. Peavine Capital LLC now owns 6,968 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,290,000 after purchasing an additional 5,650 shares during the period. Wechter Feldman Wealth Management Inc. increased its position in Apple by 29.1% during the 2nd quarter. Wechter Feldman Wealth Management Inc. now owns 2,918 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $540,000 after purchasing an additional 657 shares during the period. Parallel Advisors LLC increased its position in Apple by 3.6% during the 2nd quarter. Parallel Advisors LLC now owns 96,213 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $17,810,000 after purchasing an additional 3,336 shares during the period. Finally, United Capital Management of KS Inc. purchased a new position in Apple during the 3rd quarter valued at $3,860,000. 57.05% of the stock is currently owned
Get Apple alerts: In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through this link . 0.05% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
A number of analysts have recently commented on the stock. Canaccord Genuity restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday. Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and set a $185.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Friday. UBS Group restated a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, January 14th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and set a $228.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, January 11th. Finally, HSBC cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and dropped their target price for the company from $200.00 to $160.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 9th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the company. The company presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $195.74.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $156.82 on Tuesday. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $142.00 and a fifty-two week high of $233.47. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The stock has a market capitalization of $770.79 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.17, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.49 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $2.07 EPS. Apple’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. Sell-side analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 earnings per share for the current year.
